summary: SkyAI, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, announcing its intention to commence a cash tender offer for up to 95% of each class of its common stock, cash pre-funded warrants, cryptocurrency pre-funded warrants and strategic advisor warrants at $3.00 per share, expected to start on or about October 15, 2026. The offer will run 10 business days unless extended, contingent on at least 50% of each class being validly tendered and not withdrawn, and on SOL remaining above $100 per SOL. SkyAI holds ~600,000 SOL and ~80% of required cash. Watch for actual commencement via Schedule TO, SOL price volatility, and tender participation.
